items.name: Option A — AREX airport train to Seoul Station
items.detail: Brief said '45 min, $7' — that matches neither official product (Flag F4).
items.verified: Seoul Metropolitan Government: AREX Express 43 min (T1) / 51 min (T2) to Seoul Station, ₩13,000; All-stop 59 min (T1) / 66 min (T2), ₩4,150–4,750. Recheck timetable for arrival date.

source.label: Seoul Metropolitan Government — getting to Seoul from Incheon Airport

items.name: Option B — Airport limousine bus toward Myeongdong
items.detail: Brief said '$13'. Route/stop not specified in brief.
items.verified: Seoul city page: limousine buses ≈60–80 min depending on route/traffic, ₩5,000–15,000 by bus. Operator route 6001 (Dongdaemun–Myeongdong) lists Myeongdong Station stop, adult ₩17,000 — confirm current fare/stop.

days.label: Mon 2 Nov
days.title: N Seoul Tower (Namsan) & Myeongdong
days.transit: Brief: bus to Namsan (≈31 min claimed — unverified). Official tower directions: Myeongdong Stn (Line 4) Exit 3 → 10–15 min walk to cable-car boarding, or Namsan circular bus. Verify live route in Naver Map / KakaoMap on the day.

items.name: N Seoul Tower Observatory + Namsan Cable Car
items.detail: Brief hours '10:00–10:30' and '$31 each' are wrong/approximate (Flag F3).
items.verified: VisitKorea (KTO): Observatory Mon–Fri 10:00–22:30, Sat–Sun 10:00–23:00, open all year; adult ₩29,000. Operator: cable car 10:00–23:00, adult round trip ₩15,000 / one-way ₩12,000, Myeongdong Stn Exit 3 + 10–15 min walk. Combined ≈ ₩44,000/person if both ridden round-trip.

source.label: VisitKorea (KTO) — N Seoul Tower

flags.title: Year typo in brief: 'Nov 2, 2006'
flags.detail: Every weekday in the brief matches Nov 2026 exactly (1 Nov 2026 = Sunday … 16 Nov = Monday), and 'Nov 2, 2006' would be a Thursday, not the brief's Monday. This guide therefore uses 2026 and flags it rather than hiding it. Confirm the year on your flight/hotel bookings.

source.label: Brief itself (Day 2 header) — no external source; calendar check 2026

flags.title: Day 3 (Tue 3 Nov): Gyeongbokgung Palace & Guard Ceremony are closed
flags.detail: Official palace site: closed Tuesdays. Move palace+Bukchon to Day 8 (Sun, open) or Days 4/6/7. Bukchon/tea-house parts of Day 3 can stay.

source.label: Gyeongbokgung Palace (official) — Hours & Admissions

flags.title: Day 2 tower hours/cost in brief are wrong
flags.detail: Brief '10:00–10:30, $31'. Official: observatory Mon–Fri 10:00–22:30 / Sat–Sun 10:00–23:00, adult ₩29,000; cable car 10:00–23:00, adult return ₩15,000. '10:30' was the closing time misread as a range.

source.label: VisitKorea (KTO) — N Seoul Tower

flags.title: Day 1 'AREX 45 min / $7' and 'bus $13' match no official fare
flags.detail: Official Seoul city page: AREX Express 43/51 min ₩13,000; All-stop 59/66 min ₩4,150–4,750; limousine bus ₩5,000–15,000 by route (6001 lists ₩17,000). Use KRW figures from the operator, not the brief's dollars.

source.label: Seoul Metropolitan Government — airport transfers

flags.title: Most cafés, shops, restaurants & bars have no official page — hours/prices unverified
flags.detail: Solsot, Hanjungsun, Blue Elephant branch, Café Far Ben, Rain Report, Jayeondo, Chwihyang, Soul Market, Pig Restaurant 2, Hongojib, Crystal Jade branch, Sookhee, Break Silence, dakgalbi/galbitang spots, Coffee It House, Haeundae Amso Galbi timing: left blank under 'verified' and marked 'Needs check'. source.label: Visit Seoul (official city guide) — area context only

flags.title: Sky Capsule: no round-trip ticket exists; booking opens Tue 07:00, 4 weeks ahead
flags.detail: Brief says 'book round trip'. Officially the capsule is one-way per station (Mipo↔Cheongsapo, Nov–Feb 08:30–18:00); buy the return as a separate one-way, Beach Train, or walk. For Tue 10 Nov, tickets open Tue ~13 Oct 2026 07:00 KST on the official booking page — sells out.

source.label: Haeundae Blueline Park (official) — booking guide

flags.title: BUSAN X the SKY is planned twice (Day 10 optional + Day 12)
flags.detail: Do it once. Day 12's 10:00–11:30 slot is the firmer plan; Day 10 late-afternoon is the sunset alternative. Official hours 10:00–21:00 (last admission 20:30) either day.

source.label: VisitKorea (KTO) — BUSAN X the SKY

flags.title: Brief wording slips (kept, but corrected in the guide)
flags.detail: 'Namsun Tower' = Namsan / N Seoul Tower; 'Myeongdog' = Myeongdong; 'Musina Standard' = Musinsa Standard; 'Marge Sherwood' = Margesherwood; 'LCT Landmaek' = LCT Landmark; 'Gukje Marker' = Gukje Market; DDP described as 'converted warehouses' (that is Seongsu — DDP is a purpose-built design complex); Day 4 numbering repeats '6'. None change the plan, all corrected above.

source.label: DDP (official) — operating information

flags.title: Trip is incomplete at both ends in the brief

source.label: Korail (official) — for the two unbooked KTX legs

flags.title: All brief transit times are unverified estimates
flags.detail: 'Bus 31 min to Namsan', 'subway 47 min to COEX', '2 buses 1 h 17 m to Gamcheon', 'Busan Station Uber 1 h / $20–$30', '8-min walk in Hongdae' etc. come only from the brief.
